title: Roasted Green Beans with Lemon and Sesame
description: The use of lemon and sesame adds a touch of brightness and nuttiness often found in Mediterranean dishes, while sesame is a common ingredient in many Asian cuisines, coming together for a delicious fusion of flavors with this green bean side dish.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss the green beans with olive oil, salt, and pepper until they are well-coated.
Spread the green beans in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Sprinkle lemon zest, sesame seeds, and minced garlic over the green beans.
Roast for 15 minutes, or until the green beans are tender-crisp and slightly caramelized.

title: Turkey & Barley Soup
description: This soup is a great way to use up leftover Thanskgiving turkey, or you could use cooked chicken or other cooked protein. It's quick an easy to make, and makes enough to feed a crowd (or have plenty of leftovers for meal prepping)! Barley provides a nutty flavor and chewy texture, but you could use another grain like brown rice or quinoa.
ingredients: 2 cups (about 10 oz) cooked turket breast (shredded or diced)
steps: Add the olive oil to a soup pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, and mushrooms to the pot. Sauté for 8 to 10 minutes, or until the onions start to turn clear.
Add the barley, broth, and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the turkey. Season with the salt and pepper. Cook until the turkey is heated, then serve.

title: Garbanzo Bean Salad Quick Recipe
description: Beans and legumes are one of the healthiest carbohydrates you can eat with diabetes. Most people say they like beans, but are unsure of how to incorporate more into their diet. Try this delicious salad packed with fiber, protein and flavor!
ingredients: 1 (15.5 ounce) can chickpeas (garbanzo beans) (rinsed and drained)
steps: In a medium salad bowl, mix together all salad ingredients.
In a small bowl, whisk together dressing ingredients. Pour over bean mixture and toss to coat.

title: Meatball Kabobs
description: These meatballs make a fun family meal. Or, you can also serve them on a platter as an appetizer next time you are entertaining.
ingredients: 8 oz cremini (baby bella) mushrooms (fresh, cut in half if needed to make 12 pieces)
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Set aside.
Combine the egg whites, Parmesan cheese, garlic, ground turkey, salt (optional), and pepper. Mix well and make 12 meatballs. Refrigerate the meatballs for at least 30 minutes.
To prepare the onion, cut in half. Cut each half into quarters. Then cut each quarter into 3 sections, for a total of 12 onion pieces.
Skewer 2 meatballs, 2 tomatoes, 1 mushroom, and 1 piece of onion alternating on each skewer.
In a small bowl, whisk the balsamic vinegar and olive oil together.
Place the kabobs on the baking sheet and brush the kabobs on all sides with the balsamic and olive oil mixture. Reserve the marinade.
Bake the kabobs for 10 minutes. Brush all sides with the marinade again and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes. The meatballs should be cooked to an internal temperature of at least 165 degrees F.

title: Sautéed Cabbage with Lemon Butter
description: This low-carb Sautéed Cabbage with Lemon Butter adds a gourmet touch to your health-conscious dining, offering a satisfying and flavorful option for those seeking a delicious twist on a classic vegetable dish.
steps: Add the olive oil to a large skillet and heat on medium-high.
Sauté the shredded cabbage until tender but still crisp, about 3–5 minutes.
Zest and juice the lemon.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter and stir in the water, lemon zest, lemon juice, and poppy seeds.
Pour the lemon butter over the sautéed cabbage and season with salt and pepper. Serve warm.

title: Lemon Thyme Greek Frozen Yogurt
description: Serve this frozen yogurt with fresh raspberries for a festive dessert.
steps: Prepare an ice cream maker if using. If not using, omit this step.
Combine sugar substitute, water, thyme, lemon zest and lemon juice in a small sauce pan. Heat to a boil and then remove from heat to cool. Remove thyme sprig.
Once the lemon mixture is cooled, whisk in to the Greek yogurt. Pour into the ice cream maker and churn until frozen and thick. Serve immediately and freeze leftovers in a plastic container.
If not using an ice cream maker, whip mixture with an electric mixer or by hand with a whisk for 3 minutes. Add to a plastic container and freeze.

title: Grilled Seafood and Quinoa Salad with Mango and Avocado
description: Latin American influence permeates this colorful recipe full of bold taste and textures. You can add any leftover cooked meats or seafood to this recipe.
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked black beans or edamame
1 med jalapeño pepper (stemmed and finely chopped)
steps: Combine orange juice, lime juice, honey, salt, and cayenne pepper in a small mixing bowl. Mix well and set aside.
Cook the quinoa according to directions in water. Fluff quinoa with a fork. If any liquid remains, continue simmering until it is absorbed. Let the quinoa cool completely.
Toss the shrimp and scallops with the olive oil in a bowl.
Heat a grill pan or sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp and scallops and sear until pink and just cooked through, about 2 minutes per side. Remove from the pan and let cool.

Place the cooled quinoa in a large bowl and add the shrimp and scallops, beans, jalapeno, bell pepper, tomato, scallions, mango and avocado. Pour the dressing over the mixture and toss gently to combine.
Divide the salad among four plates or bowls and scatter cilantro leaves over each.

title: Roasted Fall Vegetables
description: So easy—just three steps from start to finish. Roasting wakes up the sweetest flavors in these veggies.
ingredients: 1 head (about 1 lb) cauliflower (cut into small florets)
1 lbs fresh Brussels sprouts (trimmed and cut in half)
steps: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a baking sheet with the cooking spray.
In a large bowl, mix together all ingredients. Pour the vegetables onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake on the lower oven rack for 25 minutes.

title: Feelin’ Your Oats Burgers
description: In this recipe, author Steve Petusevsky has you make a rectangular patty from the oat mixture and then cut it into individual burgers. However, you can shape the burgers by stamping rounds with a glass. Nutritional yeast is available at natural food stores.
ingredients: 1 tbsp Italian herb blend (dried, oregano, rosemary, and thyme)
4 1/2 cup old-fashioned rolled oats (not instant oats)
steps: Place the water, soy sauce or tamari, onions, celery, herbs, walnuts, and yeast, if using, in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil over high heat. Boil 4 minutes and then add oats. Stirring constantly, simmer 5 minutes until the mixture is the consistency of really thick wet sand.
Scoop the mixture into an 11 × 7–inch baking pan. Pat the mixture until it is spread evenly.
Preheat oven to 375ºF. Place the uncovered pan in the center of the oven and bake about 30 minutes.
Remove pan from oven and cool slightly. Keep oven set to 375ºF.
With a spatula, cut oat mixture into rectangular burgers. Remove burgers to a baking pan with sides and bake another 10 minutes until crisp.

title: Cottage Cheese Pancakes
description: These tasty Cottage Cheese Pancakes are packed with protein to keep you fueled through the morning. Top them with some fresh berries for a bright start to your morning.
ingredients: 2 cup cottage cheese (low fat, no added salt)
steps: In a blender or food processor, combine the low-fat cottage cheese, eggs, whole wheat flour, baking powder, vanilla extract, sugar substitute, and salt. Blend until the mixture is smooth and well combined.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-low heat and lightly grease it with cooking spray or a small amount of oil.
Pour pancake batter onto the skillet to create pancakes of your desired size (usually about 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake).
Cook the pancakes for about 2–3 minutes on one side or until you see small bubbles forming on the surface and the edges start to set.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1–2 minutes on the other side or until they are golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the pancakes from the skillet and keep them warm while you cook the remaining batter.

title: Apple and Gorgonzola Cheese Salad
description: This crowd pleaser includes sweet fall apples that balance out the pungent flavor of Gorgonzola cheese. Pair the salad with roasted chicken, turkey or pork tenderloin.
steps: Coat the apples with 2 tbsp lemon juice and set aside. Place the carrot slices and mixed greens on a platter. Top with the onion and set aside.
Whisk together the orange juice, remaining 2 tbsp lemon juice, honey and mustard. Slowly add the oil in a thin stream, whisking constantly.
Add the apples to the salad. Top with walnuts and cheese. Drizzle on the vinaigrette.

title: Celery Sticks
description: Nutrition information for celery sticks

title: Chicken and Cucumber Pita with Yogurt Sauce
description: This protein-packed pita is perfect for a lunch that will power you through the afternoon. Tasty chicken and crunchy cucumbers come together with a zesty, creamy yogurt sauce for a diabetes-friendly meal.
ingredients: 1 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts (sliced into strips)
4 small whole grain pocket style pitas (warmed)
steps: In a bowl, add the chicken strips to the Italian dressing, ensuring they are well-coated. Let them marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat. Cook the marinated chicken strips until fully cooked and the chicken has reached an internal temperature of 165 degrees F, about 5-7 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, fresh lemon juice, minced garlic, chopped fresh mint, and black pepper. Set aside.
Warm the whole-wheat pita pockets according to package instructions.
Spread about 2 Tbsp of yogurt sauce inside each pita.
Fill each pita with the cooked chicken strips, cucumber slices, cherry tomatoes, and red onion.

title: Tropical Tuna Salad Cups
description: Zesty and fresh, these low-carb tuna salad lettuce cups make a satisfying lunch or light dinner.
serving_size: 2 lettuce leaves + ¾ cup tuna salad
ingredients: 1, 12 oz. can Chunk Light Tuna in Water
1/3 cup light mayonnaise (extra virgin olive oil)
steps: Place the drained tuna in a medium bowl and gently stir in the avocado and mango.
Mix the mayonnaise, lime juice, and lime zest together in a small bowl then gently combine with the tuna mixture.
Place the lettuce cups on a platter. Divide the tuna mixture between the lettuce leaves and top each with the chopped pistachios.

title: Italian Ground Turkey & Potato Frittata
description: A frittata—a thick omelet—makes a quick supper. It is perfect for a busy weekday meal. All you need are a few vegetables, some ground turkey, and eggs and you can have your meal ready in 15 to 20 minutes.
ingredients: 1/4 lbs lean ground turkey (99% fat free)
1/2 lbs russet or baking potatoes (cut into 1/2-inch cubes (about 1 1/2 cups))
steps: Preheat the broiler.

Heat the oil in a medium, ovenproof, nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the potatoes and sauté 3 minutes. Add the ground turkey, Italian seasoning, and onion, sauté for 3-5 minutes, stirring several times.
Add the spinach, mushrooms, and garlic. Continue to cook 1 to 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, whish the whole eggs, egg whites, and milk together. Tear the basil into small pieces and add to the egg mixture along with the black pepper.

Pour egg mixture into the skillet and gently stir vegetables to make sure the egg mixture spreads throughout the pan. Press the turkey and vegetables into the egg mixture. Turn the heat to low and cook 10 minutes. Frittata will be mostly cooked through.
Place the frittata under the broiler for 1 to 2 minutes to brown. Watch to make sure the top doesn’t brown too much.
To serve, loosen frittata around edges, cut in half, and slip each half onto an individual plate.

title: Blueberry Almond Pancakes
description: High fiber, lower in carbs, gluten free, no added sugar, and high in protein - these are not your average pancakes! How did we do it? We replaced wheat flour with almond flour, used a mashed banana instead of sugar, and added ground flax seed for extra fiber. Just one of these pancakes will power you through your morning!
steps: Add the eggs, egg whites, ricotta cheese, vanilla, almond milk, banana, lemon juice, and lemon zest to a blender. Blend until smooth.
In a small bowl, combine the almond flour, ground flax seed, and baking powder. Add the dry mixture to the liquid mixture in the blender and blend until smooth.

Coat a nonstick saute pan with cooking spray and place over medium heat. Scoop a scant 1/3 cup of the pancake batter into the pan and top with 4-5 blueberries. Let cook until the edges begin to brown (2-3 minutes); then flip the pancake to continue to cook an additional 2-3 minutes. Remove from the pan and repeat the process for the remaining 5 pancakes.

title: High-Fiber, Gluten-Free Brownies
description: Don’t be afraid of the black beans in this recipe. You can’t taste them and they give a nutrition kick and fiber boost that you won’t find in regular brownies. Try topping them with fresh raspberries too.
ingredients: 3 large eggs (1 egg plus 2 egg whites)
1/4 cup low calorie sugar substitute (plus 1 tbsp)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Spray a 9 by 9-inch square baking pan with cooking spray.
In a blender, puree the beans with the oil and water. Add the eggs, cocoa, low- or no-calorie sweetener, coffee, and vanilla and blend well.
Add the baking mix to blender and pulse until just incorporated. Stir in mini chocolate chips. Pour into the prepared pan.
Bake for 18-20 minutes
Let cool at least 15 minutes before cutting and removing from the pan. Cut into 12 equal-sized brownies.

title: Gluten-Free Parmesan Biscuits
description: These biscuits taste like they were made at a restaurant. Count your carbs and you can work these into your meal plan. They go great with a nice bowl of healthy soup.
ingredients: 1 cup baking mix (gluten-free, such as Pamela’s)
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.
In a medium bowl, mix together baking mix and margarine. Use a fork and hands to mix into course crumbs.
Add milk to mixture and stir with a fork. Add Parmesan cheese and incorporate into mixture.
Drop about 1 Tbsp. at a time of dough mixture on baking sheet for each biscuit. Bake for 12 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Basil Pesto Cream
description: This basil pesto cream is a simple, flavorful sauce made with fresh basil, garlic, and a touch of creaminess using skim milk and non-fat cottage cheese. It adds a rich, herby taste to pasta, vegetables, or protein dishes.
steps: Place the spinach, garlic, shallot, Parmigiano-Reggiano, and basil in food processor. Process to a paste.
With the motor running, add the cottage cheese and oil. Process until smooth. Add milk to achieve the desired consistency, if needed.

title: Signature Skillet Supper
description: Barbara Seelig-Brown loves creating versatile recipes that you can tailor to your family’s preferences. Use this basic concept and vary the veggies and seasoning for a different taste each time you make this dish. This is also great because it’s a one-pot dish. Barbara also recommends trying it with ground turkey or ground buffalo, which has almost no saturated fat.
steps: Place olive oil in large sauté pan or skillet. Add beef, onions, and garlic and cook until beef is browned.
Add vegetables and the seasoning, and mix well. Add the noodles and mix well. Add the broth and enough water to cover everything.
Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until noodles are tender, approximately 15 minutes.

title: Gluten-Free English Muffin
description: Nutrition information for gluten-free English muffin

title: Poached Eggs with Sautéed Greens
description: This colorful breakfast is a healthy way to start your day! Mixed greens provide fiber and nutrients for a diabetes-friendly meal that you’ll feel good about eating.
ingredients: 4 cup mixed greens (such as spinach, kale, Swiss chard; chopped)
2 slice whole grain bread (toasted, cut in half)
steps: Fill a wide, shallow pan with water and bring it to a gentle simmer. Add a splash of vinegar to the water.
Crack each egg into a small bowl.
Carefully slide each egg into the simmering water, one at a time. Poach for 3–4 minutes for a runny yolk, or longer for a firmer yolk.
While the eggs are poaching, heat oil in a separate skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
Add the chopped mixed greens to the skillet and sauté until wilted.
Season the greens with​ salt and ​pepper.
Remove the poached eggs from the water using a slotted spoon and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess water.
Serve the poached eggs on a bed of sautéed greens with whole-grain bread on the side.

title: Zesty Broccolini and Garlic
description: Broccolini is similar in taste and texture to broccoli, but with longer, thinner stalks, and small florets. This simple, flavorful recipe is a quick and easy way to prepare broccolini. You can prepare it in the time it takes to cook your main entree. If you can't find broccolini, you can easily use broccoli instead.
steps: Heat the oil over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and sauté for about 5 to 6 minutes, or just until the garlic starts to brown.
Add in the broccolini, broth, and crushed red pepper. Cover the pan and let it steam on medium-high heat until the broccolini turns bright green and is tender, about 5 to 6 minutes.
Add in the lemon juice and zest, and serve immediately.

title: Mediterranean Chicken Pita
description: Repurpose leftover chicken on this simple and delicious sandwich! It's a perfect quick and easy work-from-home lunch, or a busy weeknight dinner. If you don't have tzatziki sauce, you could use plain Greek yogurt instead. Double Up: Use leftovers from our Greek Yogurt-Marinated Chicken recipe for even more flavor!
serving_size: 1 pita pocket (including, ½ pita bread, 2 ½ oz chicken, 2 tbsp sauce, ½ cup vegetables and 2 tbsp almonds)
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat tzatziki sauce (or nonfat plain Greek yogurt)
2 whole whole grain pocket style pitas (cut in half to make 4 pita pockets)
steps: In a medium mixing bowl, mix together the chicken and tzatziki sauce. Stuff ½ cup of the chicken mixture into each pita pocket.
Top each filled pita pocket with ¼ cup cucumbers, ¼ cup tomatoes, and 2 Tbsp sliced almonds.

title: Parmesan Crusted Chicken
description: A flavorful and versatile chicken recipe, serve this as a main entrée with vegetables or over a salad. It’s also kid-friendly and much healthier than any frozen chicken nugget.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts (cut into 12 thin strips)
steps: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.
In a shallow dish, mix together cornmeal, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder and black pepper.
In another shallow baking dish, whisk together egg whites.
Dip chicken breast strip in egg mixture and then drench in cornmeal mixture. Coat well and place on baking sheet. Repeat procedure for all chicken strips.
Spray chicken strips with cooking spray. Bake 15-20 minutes or until done; turn chicken pieces over halfway through cooking time.

title: Pesto Deviled Eggs
description: Pesto Deviled Eggs are a flavorful and elegant twist on the classic recipe. The combination of pesto, mayonnaise, and Dijon mustard creates a creamy and zesty filling that pairs wonderfully with the natural richness of hard-boiled eggs. These deviled eggs make a great appetizer for parties or a tasty addition to your brunch spread.
steps: Place the eggs in a single layer in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10–12 minutes.
Transfer the boiled eggs to an ice water bath to cool.
Once the eggs are cool, peel them and cut them in half lengthwise. Remove the yolks and place them in a bowl.
In the bowl with the egg yolks, add mayonnaise, prepared basil pesto, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper. Mash and mix the ingredients together until smooth.
Spoon or pipe the pesto filling into the hollowed-out egg whites.
Chill the deviled eggs in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Egg Souffle
description: This is a light and fluffy egg soufflé with added veggies.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F.

Coat a sauté pan with cooking spray over medium heat. Sauté the kale and onions until the onions are just cooked through, about 5-6 minutes. Add the salt (optional), Herbs d’Provence, and turkey sausage. Set aside to cool.
Once the vegetables and meat are cool, stir in the egg substitute and set aside.
In a clean bowl, combine the egg whites and cream of tartar. Using an electric mixer, whip the egg whites to stiff peaks.

Gently fold the egg whites into the egg and vegetable mixture, and pour it into a 2 1/2 quart round baking dish. (You can also use an 8-inch square dish. Be sure not to coat baking dish with cooking spray or the soufflé will not rise.)
Bake for 30 minutes. Cut the soufflé into four equal pieces and serve immediately.
Note: The soufflé will fall a little once removed from the oven, this is normal.

title: Grilled Tilapia with Crunchy Corn Salsa & Arugula
description: This grilled tilapia is a fresh and flavorful dish that fits in the Low fat and Low Carb eating pattern. Tender tilapia fillets are grilled to perfection and served with a vibrant salsa made from crunchy corn, tomatoes, onions, and cilantro, all atop a bed of peppery arugula.
serving_size: 4 oz tilapia, ¾ cup salsa, 1 cup arugula
ingredients: 2 cup fresh or frozen corn kernels (thawed if frozen)
4 fillets (4–5 oz each) tilapia (fresh or frozen, thawed)
steps: In a large bowl, combine corn, red bell pepper, red onion, jalapeño, rice vinegar, olive oil, and cilantro. Toss well and set aside.
Pat the tilapia fillets dry with a paper towel. Spray with cooking spray on both sides. Sprinkle evenly with cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper.

Preheat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat. Spray the pan with oil. Grill the tilapia for 3–4 minutes per side, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Remove from heat and let rest for a minute.
Divide the arugula among 4 plates. Place a grilled tilapia fillet on top of the arugula. Spoon the crunchy corn salsa over and around the fish.

title: Baked Blueberry Almond Oatmeal
description: A hearty baked oatmeal made with oats, chia, flax, and hemp seeds, folded with blueberries and topped with non-fat Greek yogurt and toasted almonds. This fiber- and protein-rich breakfast offers balanced nutrition with heart-healthy fats and no added sugars.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease or line a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Spread the almonds on a rimmed baking sheet. Toast in the oven for 5–8 minutes, until lightly browned and fragrant.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, almond milk, vanilla, and sugar free brown sugar alternative until smooth and creamy.
In a large bowl, stir together the chia seeds, flaxseed, rolled oats, hemp hearts, almond flour, cinnamon, baking powder, and salt.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until fully combined. The batter will thicken slightly as the chia and flax seeds absorb the liquid.
Gently fold in the blueberries.
Spread the mixture evenly in the prepared loaf pan. Bake for 30–35 minutes, turning the pan halfway through, until the center is set and the top is lightly golden and beginning to crack.

Let the oatmeal cool for 10 minutes before slicing into 6 equal portions. Serve warm, topped with ¼ cup low-fat Greek yogurt and 1 tablespoon slivered almonds per serving. Wrap cooled leftovers and store in the refrigerator.

title: Chicken Nacho Casserole
description: This low-fat chicken nacho casserole is a warm, comforting dish made with chicken, beans, vegetables, and bold spices. It has all the flavors of nachos baked into one easy meal. It’s simple to prepare and great for a filling, family‑friendly dinner.
ingredients: 1 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts (cut into small pieces)
1 (15 ounce) can no-salt-added black beans (drained and rinsed)
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Spray a 2 ½-quart baking dish with cooking spray.
Season the chicken with black pepper. Spray a large sauté pan with cooking spray and heat over medium-high. Add the chicken and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, black beans, chili powder, cumin, and garlic powder to the pan. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour the chicken mixture into the baking dish. Sprinkle on the cheese and then top with the crushed tortilla chips. Bake for 12 minutes or until the cheese is melted.

title: Cucumber Lemon Water
description: Liven up water by infusing it with fruit and herbs! Adding sliced cucumber, lemon, and fresh herbs adds a subtle flavor to plain water without adding any sugar or calories. Try other combinations like watermelon and rosemary, pineapple and mint, or anything else you can come up with!
steps: Slice the cucumber and lemon into thin slices and add to a large pitcher.
Gently crush the basil and mint leaves with your hand and add them to the pitcher. Top with 10 cups water.
Refrigerate water overnight before serving to fully infuse the flavors.

title: Almond Butter
description: Nutrition information for 1 Tbsp Almond Butter

title: Seared Tuna with Pesto Sauce
description: This seared tuna with pesto sauce is a quick, flavorful meal that feels special but is easy to make. The tuna cooks in just a few minutes and pairs well with a fresh, herby pesto. It’s a simple way to enjoy a high‑protein, low-carb dish that’s light, satisfying, and full of bright flavors. Serve it with your favorite non-starchy vegetables and whole grains for a balanced meal.
ingredients: 1 lbs ahi tuna fillets (divided into 4, 4-oz portions)
steps: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Lay the tuna fillets in the hot oil and sear for 3-4 minutes on one side. Flip the tuna and apply 1 Tbsp. pesto sauce to each filet. Cook for additional 3-4 minutes.
